The standard barycentric coordinate formula using the cross product approach:

For point p in triangle (a, b, c), the barycentric coordinates (u, v, w) are:
- u = area of PBC / area of ABC
- v = area of APC / area of ABC  
- w = area of ABP / area of ABC

Using the cross product (in 2D, cross product of (x1,y1) and (x2,y2) is x1*y2 - x2*y1):
- area of triangle = |cross| / 2

So:
- u = ((b - p) × (c - p)) / ((b - a) × (c - a))
- v = ((c - p) × (a - p)) / ((b - a) × (c - a))
- w = 1 - u - v
